# useScrollOverflowHookUsage - A row of active filters that scrolls sideways. useScrollOverflow reports which edge has hidden filters, and the strip fades only that edge: none while every filter fits, the end at the start, both mid-scroll and the start at the end. Adding or removing a filter updates the fades, and in a right-to-left layout the start edge is on the right.
